## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: narrow, tech-led top performance (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 Technology in Top 5) and mixed large-cap divergences (AAPL, META ABOVE TREND vs NVDA, ORCL, LRCX BELOW TREND) supporting no clear directional bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.56%); Energy: 7/10 positive. Communication showing pockets of strength: TTWO RECOVERY (1W: +3.83% | 1M: -7.85%); Communication: 5/10 positive. Consumer Staples steady: PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +3.15%); Consumer Staples: 6/14 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials/Industrials pressure: Industrials: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -8.26%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -8.71%); Industrials: 4/15 positive. Healthcare soft: AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%), NVS BELOW TREND (1W: -13.13% | 1M: -8.39%); Healthcare: 5/17 positive. Utilities lag pockets: CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -4.90%); Utilities: 2/10 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +3.15%), IBM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +5.04%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk noted.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SLB CORRECTION (1W: -7.29% | 1M: +2.95%), SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -7.32%). Weakness concentrated in semis/tech and selective cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +12.21% | 1M: -5.57%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%). Watch PANW and TTWO (RECOVERY) as tactical bounces versus larger-cap tech dispersion.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, internal rotation; many large names diverging. Key: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -8.15% | 1M: -14.76%), SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -15.54%); Technology: 9/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft on the week with mixed internals. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.06% | 1M: +2.69%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.30%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -3.57%); Financials: 6/20 positive — style mixed / no clear leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names fracturing and headline-driven downside. JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -3.24% | 1M: +2.12%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -3.29%), AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -5.71%); Healthcare: 5/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and resilient mega-cap tech (AAPL, META, XOM) while reducing exposure to below-trend semicap names (NVDA, LRCX, ASML) and weak consumer cyclicals. Monitor PANW and TTWO RECOVERY setups as tactical opportunities; style remains mixed with narrow leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%), QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%). BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.26%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%), AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Energy: 7/10 positive) and pockets of Technology leadership; BEARISH: Healthcare (Healthcare: 5/17 positive) and Materials/Industrials where breadth is weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA stabilizing above its 1W downtrend to indicate base formation; AAPL holding ABOVE TREND on continued 1W strength to confirm leadership; XOM sustaining 1M momentum to validate Energy carry. Monitor QCOM follow-through after AI-chip headline for confirmation versus distribution.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+60): new Amazon AI chip deal; QCOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.76% | 1M: +9.92%) — sentiment confirmed. MA (+50): cross-border deal; MA CORRECTION (1W: -0.83% | 1M: +1.30%) — sentiment constructive but price mixed. BA (+60): KC-46 contract; BA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.93% | 1M: -8.71%) — news positive but price still lagging (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-50): chip-equipment caution; LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.10% | 1M: -18.85%) — sentiment confirmed. AMGN (-50): product concerns; AMGN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -8.16%) — sentiment confirmed and price weakening. INTC (-55) flagged in flow but lacks sufficient short-term confirmation in this dataset—monitor if price joins the semiconductor selloff.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +11.87%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +9.11%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +4.75%) showing relative strength. Key risk is narrow tech concentration and large-cap divergence (NVDA, LRCX, ASML BELOW TREND) alongside headline-driven moves (QCOM news confirmed, BA news diverging).
